tool_input.command: ls tests/ 2>/dev/null; git stash && bun test 2>&1 | tail -30; git stash pop
tool_input.description: Check if test failure pre-exists before my change

result:
Both checks pass.

The bug was that `routes/admin.ts` defined `registerAdminRoutes` (mounting `GET /admin/posts` behind the `auth` middleware) but nothing ever called it — `src/app.ts` only wires up `registerWebRoutes`, which never invoked the admin route file. I fixed this by importing and calling `registerAdminRoutes(router)` inside `registerWebRoutes` in `routes/web.ts`, right after `registerAuthRoutes(router)`, so it shares the same router (and its `auth`/`guest` aliases) as the rest of the app. I also added `tests/AdminPostController.test.ts`, which asserts a guest hitting `/admin/posts` is redirected to `/login` rather than getting a 404, to guard against this route group being dropped again. No other files were touched, and the controller's existing behavior (returning `{ data: [...] }` with every post newest-first) is unchanged.
